description: Read one of your application tracker entries with its latest run, masked answers, current parked questions, saved screening choices and next action. Use exactly one application_id or run_id from list_applications. A pending run may have no tracker entry yet. The screening action requires a current review version and offered saved choices for every question. For open_review, direct the user to application_run.review_url. Superseded runs never request another answer or approval. Never retries or sends an application.

application_id.description: Provide this or run_id, never both.

run_id.description: An owned pending or completed run; provide this or application_id.

name: get_application

application_run.description: The latest ApplicationRun for this application, null if auto-apply was never used.

can_retry.description: Whether the review page can send this job again now: its questions have saved answers. Open review_url to retry it.

reason.description: Why this run was not sent, in the Applications page's words; null while it is live or once it was sent.

review_url.description: Hosted review for this run. Open this URL when next_action is open_review.

archived_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the user's own decision to retire this row from the tracker's active surfaces. Null when they never archived it.

dormant.description: Whether the tracker has stopped showing this row on its active surfaces: it was archived, or it is an applied row with no activity for 30 days. Dormant rows stay in the user's History and are restored in one click.

resume_variant.description: Null when no resume variant is linked to this application.

title: Get an application
